output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply is not checked to be below the TOKEN_LIMIT, allowing the owner to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, including a compromised exchange, causing devaluation of the token.
The transferFrom function allows the owner to transfer tokens from any address, including a compromised exchange, causing devaluation of the token.
The approve function allows the owner to approve an arbitrary number of tokens for any spender, including a compromised exchange, causing devaluation of the token.
The unfreeze function can only be called by the ICO smart contract, but it is owned by the unprotected contract, allowing the owner to disable restrictions on token transfers.
